name: Alfa Ica (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Alfa Ica (India) Ltd manufactures and markets decorative laminate sheets[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company manufactures High Pressure commercial grade decorative Laminate Sheets & Compacts in several Colors, Designs and Textures. Alfa range consists of  600+ design decors and 50+ textures. Company is also spreading its footprints globally, producing 6+ mn sq. mt. Laminates. Company sells 
laminates under the brand name of Alfaica

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.83% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 7.28% over last 3 years.
